description: Grid Transformer Power Flow Historic Half Hourly is a dataset listed in UK Power Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by UK Power Networks. Introduction UK Power Network maintains the 132kV voltage level network and below. An important part of the distribution network is the stepping down of voltage as it is moved towards the household; this is achieved using transformers. Transformers have a maximum rating for the utilisation of these assets based upon protection, overcurrent, switch gear, etc. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Network Usage. The portal shows 2026-09-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ukpn-open-data-portal.
